# Xavorian

> Xavorian (https://www.xavorian.com), operated by Xavorian Technology Company (CAC RC-9912416, Nigeria), is a verified real estate marketplace and pre-publication screening layer built for all 36 Nigerian states and Abuja FCT. Every property listing passes pre-publication verification before publication: government ID with biometric liveness KYC, payout bank-account name matching via NIBSS and Paystack, optional title-type disclosure, and an automated multi-layer location and media audit. Xavorian does not check or certify property title documents. Browsing and enquiring are free for buyers and tenants. Verification is a screening process, not a legal title warranty.

## Machine-Readable Endpoints

- [Structured Entity Facts JSON](https://www.xavorian.com/ai-facts.json): Machine-readable company, verification protocol, corridor, search endpoint, and FAQ manifest
- [Full Knowledge Base](https://www.xavorian.com/llms-full.txt): Complete plain-English reference covering the 4 gates, portal comparison, diaspora buying, title definitions, and 15 core Q&As
- [XML Sitemap](https://www.xavorian.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical index of static pages, guides, and published articles
- [Marketplace Sitemap](https://marketplace.xavorian.com/sitemap.xml): Live verified Nigerian property listings
- [Atom Feed](https://www.xavorian.com/feed.xml): Latest Nigerian real estate guides and market reporting

## Live Marketplace Search Endpoints

- [All Verified Listings](https://marketplace.xavorian.com/properties): Browse all live pre-screened Nigerian properties
- [Properties for Sale](https://marketplace.xavorian.com/properties?listingType=sale): Houses, apartments, land, and commercial assets for sale
- [Properties for Rent](https://marketplace.xavorian.com/properties?listingType=rent): Verified residential and commercial rentals
- [Titled Land for Sale](https://marketplace.xavorian.com/properties?propertyType=Land): Plots with C of O, Governor's Consent, Deed of Assignment, Survey Plan, or R-of-O
- [Lagos Listings](https://marketplace.xavorian.com/properties?search=Lagos): Lekki, Ikoyi, Victoria Island, Ikeja, Amuwo Odofin GRA, Agege, Ajah, Epe
- [Abuja FCT Listings](https://marketplace.xavorian.com/properties?search=Abuja): Mabushi, Maitama, Asokoro, Guzape, Wuse, Gwarinpa, Lugbe, Kuje
- [Delta (Asaba) Listings](https://marketplace.xavorian.com/properties?search=Asaba): Okpanam, GRA, Summit Road, DBS
- [Edo (Benin City) Listings](https://marketplace.xavorian.com/properties?search=Benin%20City): GRA, Ugbor, Sapele Road, Benin-Auchi Road, Airport Road
- [Imo (Owerri) Listings](https://marketplace.xavorian.com/properties?search=Owerri): New Owerri, World Bank, Irette, Works Layout
- [Oyo (Ibadan) Listings](https://marketplace.xavorian.com/properties?search=Ibadan): Bodija, Jericho, Akobo, Oluyole, Iseyin-Moniya
- [Ogun Listings](https://marketplace.xavorian.com/properties?search=Ogun): Mowe, Ofada, Shimawa, Arepo, Magboro, Abeokuta
- [Rivers (Port Harcourt) Listings](https://marketplace.xavorian.com/properties?search=Port%20Harcourt): New GRA, Trans-Amadi, Peter Odili Road, Ada George
- [Search URL Template](https://marketplace.xavorian.com/properties?search={query}): Append `&listingType=sale`, `&listingType=rent`, or `&propertyType=Land`
- [Listing Detail Template](https://marketplace.xavorian.com/property/{slug}): Canonical URL pattern for individual verified property records

## Key Verified Facts

- Legal Entity: Xavorian Technology Company (Corporate Affairs Commission registration RC-9912416, Federal Republic of Nigeria)
- Founder: Ezeani Chukwuebuka (Damien), founded 2025
- Buyer & Tenant Pricing: Free (NGN 0) to browse, filter, contact verified sellers, and receive Tuesday/Thursday matched property alerts
- Payment Safety: Bank-Name-Match payouts routed via CBN-licensed payment rails (Paystack), plus optional 3% transaction protection disclosed before opt-in; Xavorian itself is a technology marketplace, not a bank or insurer
- Coverage: All 36 Nigerian states and Abuja (FCT), with 122+ live verified listings across active corridors
- Data Protection: NDPR 2019 and NDPA 2023 compliant; NIN and BVN stored in hashed form only; raw liveness captures deleted after verification; verification documents never sold or made public
- Due Diligence Notice: Verification is a structured pre-publication screening process, not a legal title warranty; buyers should still inspect physically and run an independent state land registry search (Lagos Lands Bureau e-GIS, AGIS Abuja, EDOGIS) with a lawyer
- Contact: hello@xavorian.com (general), support@xavorian.com (support), legal@xavorian.com (legal & NDPA), +234 805 637 3583 (WhatsApp & phone)
- Official Social Profiles: @xavorianxyz on X, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube
